note: Per-vector level descriptors. Evidence rows are the content source for the evidence checklist shown in the output. See PRD Appendix B.

People.name: Ignoring
People.assertion: Our people do not use AI.
evidence: No written acknowledgment of AI use, or policy prohibits AI while use is observable.
People.test: Produce acknowledgment. Absent or contradicted by observable shadow use means Ignoring.
People.notes: Falsified Level 0 invalidates the whole AIP assertion.

People.name: Perceiving
People.assertion: Our people use AI. We have not measured how.
evidence: Written acknowledgment of AI use in policy, dated.
People.notes: No behavioral measurement required or expected at this level.

People.name: Assessing
People.assertion: We have looked at how our people collaborate with AI.
evidence: Baseline behavioral assessment of human-AI collaboration, dated.
People.notes: Data may be uncomfortable. Level is about seeing, not acting.

People.name: Integrating
People.assertion: What we saw changed what we do.
evidence: At least one policy or practice change traceable to baseline assessment data.
People.test: Show the change and the source finding.
People.notes: Traceability is the bar. Not activity. Not intent.

People.name: Calibrating
People.assertion: We measure continuously. Data drives governance.
evidence: Cohort-level behavioral data on defined cadence.
People.test: Produce cohort report, cadence document, anonymization validation.
People.notes: Ongoing, not episodic. Jurisdictional variants if multi-jurisdictional workforce.

People.name: Engineering
People.assertion: Human-AI collaboration is an engineered capability, continuously maintained.
evidence: Declared framework-review cadence with review artifact from prior cycle.
People.test: Show continuous assessment, attestation mechanism, declared cadence, and most recent review artifact.
People.notes: Reachable independently. Constraint rule still binds AIP aggregate.

Infrastructure.name: Ignoring
Infrastructure.assertion: AI agents do not interact with our systems.
evidence: No acknowledgment of agent interaction, or prohibited while logs show agent traffic or external scan shows scrapable surfaces.
Infrastructure.test: Inspect logs and run external scan. Contradicted denial means Ignoring.
Infrastructure.notes: Falsified Level 0 invalidates the whole AIP assertion.

Infrastructure.name: Perceiving
Infrastructure.assertion: Agents may interact with our systems. We have not measured readiness.
evidence: Acknowledgment that agents may interact with org systems.
Infrastructure.notes: No scan or inventory required or expected.

Infrastructure.name: Assessing
Infrastructure.assertion: We have scanned our infrastructure for agent readiness.
Infrastructure.test: Produce scan report, surface inventory, partner map.
Infrastructure.notes: Outer surface and inner edge both in scope.

Infrastructure.name: Integrating
Infrastructure.assertion: We have acted on what the scan showed.
evidence: Machine-readable declarations deployed (llms.txt, structured data, agent-legible identifiers).
Infrastructure.test: Show scan, remediation log, follow-up scan delta.
Infrastructure.notes: Declarations must be deployed, not drafted.

Infrastructure.name: Calibrating
Infrastructure.assertion: We scan continuously. Drift is tracked.
evidence: Outer-surface claims verified against internal reality on a cycle.
Infrastructure.test: Produce cadence record, drift log, claim-reality reconciliation.
Infrastructure.notes: Claim-reality check catches outward drift without requiring a separate vector.

Infrastructure.name: Engineering
Infrastructure.assertion: Agent-readiness is engineered into how systems are built and shipped.
evidence: Standards contributed to, or internally extended protocols in use.
Declared framework-review cadence with review artifact from prior cycle.
Infrastructure.test: Show release-gate evidence, standards contribution or internal extension, declared cadence, and most recent review artifact.
Infrastructure.notes: Reachable independently. Constraint rule still binds AIP aggregate.

Regulation.name: Ignoring
Regulation.assertion: No AI-specific laws apply to us.
evidence: No acknowledgment of exposure, or acknowledgment contradicted by regulated activity in jurisdictions the org operates, sells, or employs in.
Regulation.test: Compare declared non-exposure to operational footprint. Contradicted means Ignoring.
Regulation.notes: Falsified Level 0 invalidates the whole AIP assertion.

Regulation.name: Perceiving
Regulation.assertion: We are exposed to AI regulation. We have not mapped it.
Regulation.notes: No structured mapping required or expected.

Regulation.name: Assessing
Regulation.assertion: We have mapped our obligations across jurisdictions.
evidence: Jurisdictional coverage across operations, sales, employment footprint.
Regulation.test: Produce register with jurisdictional coverage and named gaps.
Regulation.notes: Coverage ratio is the measure, not volume of regulation.

Regulation.name: Integrating
evidence: At least primary jurisdiction fully controlled.
Regulation.test: Show the statute-to-control trace for at least one jurisdiction.
Regulation.notes: Obligation becomes action, not just document.

Regulation.name: Calibrating
Regulation.assertion: Controls cover all in-scope jurisdictions. Regulatory change is monitored.
evidence: Documented interpretations with counterparties where applicable.
Regulation.test: Produce coverage map, monitoring cadence, interpretation records.
Regulation.notes: Documented interpretations matter where ambiguity exists.

Regulation.name: Engineering
Regulation.assertion: Compliance is continuous. New jurisdictions onboard rapidly.
evidence: Obligations met as measured coverage ratio, refreshed continuously.
Declared framework-review cadence with review artifact from prior cycle.
Regulation.test: Show coverage refresh cadence, interpretation registry, jurisdiction-intake workflow, declared review cadence, and most recent review artifact.
Regulation.notes: Reachable independently. Constraint rule still binds AIP aggregate.
